title: 第1613章 尤伦娜超脱第1612章 探索帷幕
slug: 从鹰人进化为天使后我荡平诸神
lines: 露娜·安温尔踏着灰朦的长空，一路朝着帷幕的深处而去。
帷幕内外，一体两面，都位于多元宇宙之中。
但即便如此，她依旧能够一路走到帷幕的深处。
因为在这里，已经的不讲逻辑，不讲常识的地方。
在这一路上。
她遇到了无数浊世之敌。
他们被困于帷幕之内，在千年内自相残杀，但一感知到露娜·安温尔的净世气息，便眼睛猩红的朝她杀来。
在经历漫长岁月的厮杀后，露娜·安温尔精疲力竭。
但这个时候。
她依旧距离那轮白金之月，还有着不可企及的距离，这让她深深叹息，终于再也走不下去，只能退回。
不过。
在回归之后，
她也不是没有收获。
她在帷幕之后，明悟了帷幕修行法，并在浊世生灵的修行之中，探明了晋升的方式。
“浊世生灵的晋升，是要铸造伟业。”
“这样说来。”
“帷幕超凡体系，与浊世超凡体系相似，但一体两面。所以，帷幕晋升，当完成仪式！”
“完成仪式，便可晋升。但这仪式，应该是正义、光明的仪式，是净世的仪式。”
“即做出贡献，宣扬名望，创造奇迹等等。”
露娜·安温尔将她的猜测编纂成书，并找到几个自愿者实验。
果然成功。
而后。
她便将帷幕仪式法传承下去，确立帷幕修行者体系，让无数帷幕修行者受益。
同时。
她在繁星文明内部，主动建设帷幕修行者的队伍。
但她不能将之公之于众。
因为普通人的认知一但打破，便会被浊世的黑影“看到”，杀死其“存在”。
于是。
一个个暗中的帷幕组织成立，一座座暗学院出现。
露娜·安温尔始终主持大局，被无数帷幕组织尊称为“初法女士”。
但随着时间的流逝，随着帷幕修行者的增多。
大量的浊世黑影慢慢从帷幕的深处，移动至帷幕的边缘。
这些帷幕边缘的浊世黑影，大多是实力低微的浊世生灵，因为他们在帷幕深处的厮杀中，不能战胜强大的浊世之敌，所以只能流往边缘。
但这种现象的出现，也让帷幕初阶的修行者的诞生觉醒变得困难。
当然，能够在这种环境下成为超凡者，却也比之前的帷幕修行者意志更加坚定。
当几百万年过去。
六大有之地的局势都渐渐稳定下来。
而帷幕体系也已经成熟，整个繁星文明，也转为了明暗两种社会体系。
高层修行者，都恪守着帷幕的默契，不敢公开认知的壁垒。
当然，也有堕落的帷幕修行者强行公开认知壁垒，让浊世黑影屠杀了整座城市或者星球的情况出现。
但这都是少数。
认知壁垒是由佛皇和姜尤的力量合铸，除非满足一系列作死条件，认知壁垒坚固如神铁。
即便是有电视台广播，或者亲口告诉，这个认知壁垒也不会破碎。
也只有认识到有帷幕的人，才会被浊世生灵看到杀死。
content_en:
Luna Anwen walked through the gray sky and headed towards the depths of the curtain.
Inside and outside the veil, two sides of one body, all located in the multiverse.
But even so, she was still able to walk all the way to the depths of the curtain.
Because here, there is no logic or common sense.
Along the way.
She met countless enemies in troubled times.
They were trapped within the veil and killed each other for thousands of years, but as soon as they sensed Luna Anwen's pure aura, they came towards her with scarlet eyes.
After many years of fighting, Luna Anwen was exhausted.
But this time.
She was still far away from the platinum moon, which made her sigh deeply. Finally, she could no longer go forward and could only retreat.
but.
After returning,
It wasn't like she didn't gain anything.
Behind the veil, she clearly understood the practice of the veil, and discovered the method of promotion through the practice of beings in troubled times.
"The promotion of creatures in troubled times is to create great achievements."
"Put it this way."
"The Curtain Extraordinary System is similar to the Troubled World Extraordinary System, but it has two sides. Therefore, when the Curtain is promoted, the ceremony should be completed!"
"After completing the ceremony, you can be promoted. But this ceremony should be a ceremony of justice, light, and a ceremony of purifying the world."
"That is, making a contribution, spreading fame, performing miracles, etc."
Luna Anwin compiled her speculations into a book and found several volunteers to experiment with.
It was a success.
then.
She passed down the curtain ritual method and established a system of curtain practitioners, benefiting countless curtain practitioners.
at the same time.
She took the initiative to build a team of veil practitioners within the Starry Civilization.
But she couldn't make it public.
Because once ordinary people's cognition is broken, they will be "seen" by the dark shadows of the troubled world and kill their "existence".
then.
Dark curtain organizations were established one after another, and dark academies appeared one after another.
Luna Anwenl has always been in charge of the overall situation and is honored as "Lady of the First Law" by countless veil organizations.
But as time goes by, the number of veil practitioners increases.
A large number of dark shadows slowly moved from the depths of the curtain to the edge of the curtain.
Most of the dark shadows at the edge of the curtain are low-strength creatures of the troubled world. Because they cannot defeat the powerful enemies of the troubled world in the fight deep in the curtain, they can only flow to the edge.
However, the emergence of this phenomenon also makes it difficult for practitioners in the early stages of the veil to be born and awaken.
Of course, being able to become an extraordinary person in this environment is also more determined than the previous veil practitioners.
When millions of years pass.
The situation in the six major territories has gradually stabilized.
The curtain system has also matured, and the entire starry civilization has also transformed into two social systems, light and dark.
High-level practitioners all abide by the tacit understanding of the veil and dare not disclose the barriers of cognition.
Of course, there are also cases where corrupted veil practitioners forcibly expose cognitive barriers, allowing the dark shadows of troubled times to massacre entire cities or planets.
But these are a minority.
The cognitive barrier is forged by the power of Emperor Buddha and Jiang You. Unless a series of death conditions are met, the cognitive barrier is as strong as divine iron.
Even if it is broadcast on a TV station or told personally, this cognitive barrier will not be broken.
Only those who realize that there is a veil will be killed by the creatures of the troubled world.
